description: Work items for the November 7 event (compiled package v4, baseline BL-CAUSA-INDY-INIT-62df28a559c0). IDs are kept from v3 so preflight checks, contracts and defect-class tests resolve; titles, coverage and completion are rewritten for ADR-R7-001 and Rehearsal 7's findings. estimateMinutes is a planning estimate for the timed plan (requirements-compiled/v4/execution-plan.json), with its basis; it never changes scope. 'dependsOn' edges are genuine: the prerequisite produces a decision, contract, artifact or evidence the task consumes, or a normative rule forbids starting earlier (cited in the reason). 'preferenceAfter' edges are ordering preferences and are never scheduled. 'covers' uses the selector grammar of requirements-compiler (id, prefix:, regex:, doc:, origin:). satisfiedBy: new-implementation, existing-capability, operator-action, upstream-release, verification. 'phase': preflight tasks finish before the R4 timer starts (it starts at the first green bootstrap CI, R4 P5); timed tasks run inside the 420-minute ceiling. 'conditionalOn' names an owner decision that may exclude the task with approval.
